producer_report.summary: Added a challenge rule to the versioned critic prompt: "Search for ways the plan's conclusions might be wrong: counterexamples, fragile assumptions, failure modes. Name each you find as a finding." frame.critic is now version 2. A new test checks the composed critic prompt (CONTRACT plus CRITIC_FRAME) for the rule and for version 2. OLY-8-05 in docs/spec.toml now names critic.md and critic_round as its mechanism, keeps owner Ares, and its measure says it is indirect and ends `status: planning`. The critic line in docs/system-facts.md moved from 955 to 1002 of 1300, because the budget test computes it. CHANGELOG has an entry. The base had no brief-only challenge section, so planner.rs needed no change.

checks_run.note: only budgets failed: stale critic figure in system-facts.md; fixed

checks_run.command: cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test budgets --test mirrors --test drain -q

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml requirement OLY-8-05 has mechanism naming existing paths (crates/athena-context/prompts/critic.md and critic_round in crates/athena-core/src/run/planning.rs) instead of "none", keeps owner = "Ares", and its measure ends with `status: planning`; Grep confirms the paths exist and that `athena status` prints a planning line.
criteria_check.evidence: Read docs/spec.toml OLY-8-05 after the edit. The mechanism names both paths and the measure ends `status: planning`. critic.md exists, and Grep found critic_round at planning.rs:338 in the pre-edit tree. I did not run `athena status` separately. The full cargo test run passed except the budgets mismatch fixed below.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-context/prompts/critic.md contains a rule telling the critic to search for ways the plan's conclusions might be wrong (counterexamples, fragile assumptions, failure modes), and CRITIC_FRAME's version in crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs is bumped from 1 to 2; git diff shows both.
criteria_check.evidence: Edited the rule into critic.md and changed `version: 1` to `version: 2` for frame.critic in lib.rs. `git diff` shows both.

criteria_check.criterion: A new test in crates/athena-context (briefs.rs or lib.rs tests) asserts the composed critic prompt contains the challenge rule; run `cargo test -p athena-context` to see it pass, and it fails when the rule is removed from critic.md.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-context` passed 132 tests, including briefs::tests::composed_critic_prompt_carries_the_challenge_rule. It asserts both rule phrases appear in compose(CONTRACT, CRITIC_FRAME).text and that the version is 2. Removing the rule line from critic.md would fail its contains asserts. I did not run that removal.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked` all pass, including the prompt token budget tests; run each command. `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain` is run on the change and any failure is checked against the base.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo fmt --all --check` was clean. `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` finished clean. The first `cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast -q` failed only in athena-cli --test budgets, because the critic budget line in system-facts.md was stale (955 vs computed 1002). After updating the line, `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test budgets --test mirrors --test drain` passed: budgets 7/7, drain 202/202, mirrors 4/4. I ran the full suite once and all other targets passed. `cargo test -p xtask --test policy` passed 22/22. Nothing failed in the drain test, so there was nothing to compare against the base.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the change; no governance file (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) changes; docs/system-facts.md changes only if it states a critic prompt budget figure that moved.
criteria_check.evidence: Added a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased > Changed. I changed no athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflow files. system-facts.md changed on one line only, the critic budget figure, which the budgets test required.

mistakes: My first test version called to_string() on Composed and did not compile. I switched to the text field.
learnings: system-facts.md states the computed critic budget, and the athena-cli budgets test fails whenever a critic prompt edit moves it.
Composed has a public `text` field and no Display impl.
